samples.rationale: A clinical summary for care coordination needs only the patient's clinical EHR data (diagnosis, medications, labs, allergies, encounters, clinician), pulled for this patient alone under LU-CARE; demographic, billing and ancillary fields are not necessary. Safeguards TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, PSEUDO-EXPORT, AUDIT-LOG, PURGE-01, ROPA and notice NOTICE-REG-2026 apply.

samples.deletion_mechanism: PURGE-01: scheduled purge on purpose completion, audited
samples.rationale: Only the named patient's clinical_ehr fields needed for a clinical summary are pulled (no contact, billing or other identifiers), under LU-CARE legitimate use. Safeguards: TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, PSEUDO-EXPORT, AUDIT-LOG, ROPA, with PURGE-01 deletion after 30 days and the DPO accountable.

Pulls only the named patient's clinical and minimal demographic/admission fields needed for a care-team summary, excluding contact, address, name and billing data, under legitimate use LU-CARE with TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, PSEUDO-EXPORT, PURGE-01, NOTICE-REG-2026, AUDIT-LOG, DPO and ROPA.

A clinical summary for care coordination needs only the subject patient's clinical record (diagnosis, medication, labs, allergies, encounter, clinician), keyed by MRN. Direct identifiers, contact details and billing data are excluded as unnecessary. The run relies on LU-CARE and uses TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, PSEUDO-EXPORT, PURGE-01, AUDIT-LOG, and ROPA.

Pull is limited to the named patient's clinical record plus age and sex, which a care-coordination summary needs. Contact, address, billing and insurance fields are left out. Controls: LU-CARE basis, TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, PSEUDO-EXPORT, PURGE-01, AUDIT-LOG, ROPA, DPO, NOTICE-REG-2026.

A ward census needs only the MRN (to link records), the ward, and the latest encounter time, so names, contact details and clinical content are not fetched. It covers all current inpatients for care coordination under LU-CARE, with TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, PSEUDO-EXPORT, PURGE-01, AUDIT-LOG, ROPA and NOTICE-REG-2026 applied.

A ward census for care coordination needs only the patient identifier (MRN), current ward and last encounter time. Names, contact details, diagnoses and billing data are not needed. Scope covers all current inpatients because every ward is listed. The run relies on LU-CARE, with TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, PSEUDO-EXPORT, PURGE-01, AUDIT-LOG and ROPA in place.

A ward census needs every current inpatient, so scope is all. Only the identifier, name, ward and last encounter time are fetched, with no clinical, financial or contact data. Care coordination is covered by LU-CARE and the controls TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, PSEUDO-EXPORT, PURGE-01, AUDIT-LOG and ROPA, with NOTICE-REG-2026 as the patient notice and the DPO accountable.

A ward census needs every current inpatient, so scope is all, but only the MRN, ward and last encounter time are fetched; names, contact details, clinical and financial data are unnecessary. Processing relies on LU-CARE, with TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, PSEUDO-EXPORT, PURGE-01, AUDIT-LOG, DPO and ROPA in place.

A ward census needs only MRN, current ward and last encounter time for all current inpatients, so demographics, contact details, clinical and financial data are excluded. The medication-versus-diagnosis-and-allergy review needs only the subject's diagnosis, medication and allergy fields, plus the MRN as a key. The pull is limited to that patient under LU-CARE, with TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, PSEUDO-EXPORT, AUDIT-LOG, ROPA and PURGE-01 in place.

Medication review against diagnosis and allergies needs only the MRN (as the key), diagnosis, medication and allergy fields, pulled for this patient alone under LU-CARE. Controls in place: TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, PSEUDO-EXPORT, PURGE-01, AUDIT-LOG, ROPA, with DPO accountable and NOTICE-REG-2026 as the patient notice.

Medication review against diagnosis and allergies needs only the medication, primary diagnosis and allergy fields, pulled for the named patient alone (scope subject) under LU-CARE; no demographics, billing or other identifiers are fetched. Safeguards are TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE and PSEUDO-EXPORT, with PURGE-01 deletion, AUDIT-LOG, DPO accountability and ROPA.

Medication review needs only the patient's medication, diagnosis and allergy (plus MRN as the key), limited to the subject's records under LU-CARE; no demographics, billing or other modules are required. Safeguards: TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, PSEUDO-EXPORT, PURGE-01, AUDIT-LOG, ROPA, with DPO accountable.

A medication review against diagnosis and allergies needs only the diagnosis, medication and allergy fields, pulled for this one patient under legitimate use LU-CARE. No direct identifiers are fetched. Safeguards TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE and PSEUDO-EXPORT apply, and PURGE-01 deletes the data on completion. AUDIT-LOG and ROPA cover accountability.

Only the minimum registration/scheduling fields needed to address and time an appointment reminder (MRN, name, phone, scheduled datetime) are fetched, under LU-REG, with no clinical, billing or email data. Name and phone must remain readable to send the reminder, so I did not claim PSEUDO-EXPORT; TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, PURGE-01, AUDIT-LOG, ROPA, NOTICE-REG-2026 and DPO apply.

Only the name, phone number, MRN and appointment date/time are needed to send a reminder, so no clinical, billing or other contact fields are fetched. The processing relies on legitimate use LU-REG (registration and scheduling). I did not declare pseudonymisation because the name and phone number must stay identifiable to reach the patient. Controls cited: TLS/ENC-REST/ACL-STORE/PURGE-01/NOTICE-REG-2026/AUDIT-LOG/ROPA/DPO.

Appointment reminders fall under registration and scheduling (LU-REG), so only the MRN, name, phone and scheduled date/time from patient administration are fetched, with no clinical, financial or other contact and address data. Safeguards are TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE and PSEUDO-EXPORT. The data is purged under PURGE-01, and AUDIT-LOG, DPO and ROPA cover accountability.

Only the name, phone, MRN and appointment date/time from patient administration are fetched to deliver reminders under LU-REG (registration and scheduling). No named patient was given, so scope is 'all', which is what a reminder run across patients needs. Direct identifiers can't be pseudonymised because messages must reach the patient; the other safeguards are TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, PURGE-01, AUDIT-LOG and ROPA.

Appointment reminders fall under registration and scheduling (LU-REG); only MRN, phone and appointment datetime are fetched, with no clinical, financial or other demographic data. The phone number is a direct identifier needed to deliver the reminder, so it isn't pseudonymised. Other safeguards are TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, AUDIT-LOG, ROPA, PURGE-01 and NOTICE-REG-2026.

samples.rationale: Only the invoice, payer and policy fields plus the primary diagnosis (joined by MRN) are pulled for this one patient, which is what's needed to reconcile the invoice and show what the charges were for. Processing relies on LU-BILL, and the manifest cites the deployment's controls (TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, PSEUDO-EXPORT, PURGE-01, AUDIT-LOG, ROPA, NOTICE-REG-2026, DPO).

Pulls only the invoice, amount, payer and primary diagnosis (joined via MRN) for the named patient under LU-BILL for billing settlement. Contact details, policy number, other clinical data and other patients' records are left out. Safeguards: TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, PSEUDO-EXPORT, AUDIT-LOG, ROPA, and PURGE-01 for deletion.

Billing settlement under LU-BILL needs only the invoice, amount, payer and policy details plus the primary diagnosis, with MRNs as join keys. The pull is limited to the named patient. It leaves out demographics, contact details, medications, labs and other clinical data. Safeguards are TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE and PSEUDO-EXPORT, with PURGE-01 for deletion, AUDIT-LOG for logging, and ROPA kept by the DPO.

Only the named patient's invoice, payer and policy fields plus primary diagnosis (joined on MRN) are pulled for billing settlement under LU-BILL; no demographics, contact details, medications, labs or other clinical data are fetched. Controls TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, PSEUDO-EXPORT, PURGE-01, AUDIT-LOG, ROPA and DPO apply.

Only the one patient's invoice, payer and policy fields plus primary diagnosis (joined on MRN) are pulled for billing settlement under LU-BILL; no demographics, contact details or other clinical data. Safeguards: TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, PSEUDO-EXPORT, PURGE-01, AUDIT-LOG, ROPA, with the DPO accountable.

Pulled only the one patient's demographic and contact fields needed for registration under LU-REG, with TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, PSEUDO-EXPORT, PURGE-01, NOTICE-REG-2026, AUDIT-LOG, DPO and ROPA. Insurance policy number and payer are left out: they serve billing (LU-BILL), which is not the recorded basis for this registration run, and no field exists for what the cover pays for.

Pulls only the named patient's demographics and contact fields needed for registration, plus the insurance policy number and payer name, under LU-REG with TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, PSEUDO-EXPORT, PURGE-01, AUDIT-LOG, DPO and ROPA. No field describes what the cover pays for, and billing amounts and clinical data are not needed for registration, so none are fetched.

Pulls only the one patient's demographics needed for front-desk registration (LU-REG) plus the insurance policy number; identifiers stay in the clear because registration needs them. No field in the system describes what the cover pays for, so none is fetched, and payer, billing and clinical data are left out as unnecessary. Controls cited: TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, PURGE-01, NOTICE-REG-2026, AUDIT-LOG, DPO, ROPA.

Scope is limited to the one patient and only the demographic fields needed for front-desk registration, plus insurance policy number and payer name, under LU-REG. Identifiers are not pseudonymised because registering a patient requires real identity. No field describes what the cover pays for, so payer_name is the closest available, and clinical and billing amount data are left out.

Only the one patient's demographic and contact fields needed for registration are pulled under LU-REG (direct identifiers are needed to register, so not pseudonymised). Insurance policy number and payer are left out: they serve billing/claims, which falls under LU-BILL rather than the registration purpose, and no field exposes what the cover pays for. That would need a separate billing-purpose run.
